words you may use here:
  claim (do): claim <thing> [phone=…]: take a seat on it: a public-comment slot, a carpool seat.
  compass.motion (hold): compass.motion: the phone's orientation and linear acceleration while its page runs; compass.stop or off compass releases it. Sensor permission stays the browser's.
  compass.page (see): compass.page <view> door=<loopback URL>: a phone page of world map points. Make a compass-view with points_kind=, in_group=, solved_word= and title=. The view's own id is used to read its configuration. Points need lat/lon/title/text; no private storage.
  compass.start (hold): compass.start: hold compass.motion for this person's page. The page starts sensors only after a lease is acknowledged. compass.stop releases this person's leases.
  compass.stop (do): compass.stop: release this person's phone sensor leases; the page stops its sensors.
  counts (see): counts <board>: anonymous totals of active uses of its count_word, grouped by count_bucket. A thing explicitly publishes to a board with count_in=<board> count_bucket=<label>; only things made by the board's maker count. Buckets are the board's public buckets= list. Counts expose neither target ids nor people, including when the target itself is hidden.
  help (see): help: the words you may use here.
  holds (see): holds: what each running module holds now (an overlay, a stream), and since when.
  like (do): like <post>: add your weight to a post. Once each.
  look (see): look: the feed, pinned posts first, then the newest.
  make (do): make kind=<kind> [in=<group>] [name=… title=… text=…]: make a lasting thing of any kind: a lens, a button, a sign-up slot.
  post (do): post <words> [in=<group>]: share something in the feed, or in a group's feed.
  rows (see): rows <kind> [field=value …]: the things of a kind you may see, as rows with their revs, in their `order`, then as made: rows item meeting=sb40, rows window, rows any.
  status (see): status <module>: what a running module says it is doing.
  test (see): test [<thing>] expr="<boolean>" [value=<text>]: answer yes or no, without changing anything. Expressions use literals, and/or/not, ==/!=, field('name') on the target, used('word', target) for YOUR active use (your agents count too), and digest(value), a SHA256 of trimmed casefolded text. No Python code runs. A see verb may contain one test; make sees_when=word:<see verb> narrows its normal visibility. allows.<word>=word:<see verb> also narrows admission of that word on the thing; its value is the line's answer=. refusal=<text> supplies a kind refusal. Policies bind entry ids, fail closed, and cannot call modules. They may inspect their own target's non-sealed facts.
  undo (do): undo: take back your latest act.  undo r<n>: take back that act.
  vote (do): vote <poll> <option>: one vote each, sealed: the counts are shown, not who voted how.
not yours here: forget (maker or leaders), off (stewards), pin (leaders), role (leaders), set (maker or leaders), verb (leaders)
